text:
Maya: Dropping a new variant in Figma: compact top banner vs horizontal carousel for sample projects on first-run. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/newvariant (frame 'Onboard / Compact Banner vs Carousel'). Quick gut check? Alex: The banner is obvious but eats vertical space. Carousel feels lighter but might hide content behind swipes on mobile. Jess: Can we A/B test banner (expanded) vs carousel (collapsed with peek) for initial impression->start metric? 3k users per arm to start. Sam: Dev note: carousel requires accessible controls (prev/next) and proper focus management. Keep DOM order: control buttons before slides so keyboard users don't miss them. Use aria-roledescription="carousel" and aria-live for slide changes. Priya: Accessibility: banner CTA contrast is ok on desktop but drops under 4.5:1 on the mobile overlay. Carousel card text over image also fails 4.5:1. Also animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Maya: Good points. Microcopy question: CTA short labels — "Try sample" vs "Create demo". Preferences? Jess: "Try sample" wins for brevity. Enterprise variant can use "Create sample project" via org override. Alex: For carousel, maybe show a tiny badge "Example" on first load to hint swipability. But ensure it's not mistaken for a tooltip. Sam: Implementation tips: add data-qa attributes (data-qa="onboard-sample-carousel", data-qa="onboard-sample-cta"). For keyboard: left/right arrow to move slides and Enter/Space to activate CTA. Example snippet: ```
...
``` Priya: SR flow: when a slide becomes active, announce its title and short description. Use aria-atomic on the live region. Also ensure pause/play controls available for animated carousels. Maya: UX thought: banner draws eyes to CTA quicker; carousel surfaces more options. Maybe hybrid: banner for first session, then collapse to carousel on subsequent visits. Could we persist that? Jess: That hybrid sounds promising. Track events: sample_banner_impression, sample_carousel_impression, sample_click, sample_selected. We'll capture first-session vs return-session. Alex: Performance: carousel images increase payload. Use low-res blurred placeholders then lazy-load full images. Also consider a text-only compact card variant for low-bandwidth. Sam: CSS suggestion for mobile touch targets: ``` .sample-cta { min-height:44px; padding: 10px 12px; } .carousel { -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; } ``` ops-bot: Accessibility scan: frame 'Compact Banner' flagged button with no aria-describedby for info tooltip. Recommend adding aria-describedby linking to tooltip content. Priya: Also verify color tokens in Figma map to production tokens so contrast fixes survive translation. And include localized length checks for short CTAs. Maya: Plan: I'll update Figma with 1) hybrid flow notes, 2) carousel controls & live-region annotations, 3) updated contrast & prefers-reduced-motion variants, 4) mobile copy as "Try sample" and desktop full copy. Will post updated frames by EOD. Jess: I'll draft the analytics tracking spec and the A/B plan for 3k users per arm, plus the hybrid follow-up. Alex: Let's also run a quick 5-person keyboard only usability check after frames are updated. Maya: Thanks all — will ping when ready. Sam: :thumbsup: Priya: One tiny microcopy callout: if we show "(recommended)" after CTA, keep it short and test readability in translations. Maya: Noted. Will include both variants in Figma notes.
